notes:
Summary:
- Elmbridge CX Labs (mid-market online retailer). Primary goal: reduce avg handle time and improve routing via automated summarization and tag extraction from inbound email + Zendesk tickets. Looking to add suggested macros and tool-calls (e.g., issue lookup, refund flow) into agent UI.

Recent timeline (bullets):
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (Alicia). High-level requirements: subs-second tagging for hot routes; accuracy >85% for top 25 tags.
- 2026-01-28: Product demo (Diego). Showed streaming generative summarization + macro-suggestion concept. Positive reaction from support ops lead ("cuts triage time in half").
- 2026-02-05: Security questionnaire submitted. SOC2 + SAML required. Legal flagged data residency for EU customers.
- 2026-02-12: Tech deep-dive with infra (Diego + infra). Discussed Zendesk webhook vs. polling architecture, expected volume patterns (avg 3k tickets/day, 6x spikes during marketing drops).
- 2026-02-20: Signed mutual NDA; POC kickoff agreed: 2-week Zendesk sandbox POC to validate: summary quality, tag precision, macro suggestion latency under load.
- 2026-03-02: POC mid-point sync. Initial metrics: summarization ROUGE-style qps acceptable; tagging precision 78% on long-thread emails (below target).
- 2026-03-08: Trial with simulated surge (6x). Observed increased token cost and 2x latency for long threads when no KV caching. Agreed to test batch K/V caching and prefix caching.

Technical requirements / acceptance criteria (customer-specified):
- Summaries: concise 1-2 sentence agent-friendly summary + 3 bullet context lines.
- Tags: top-5 categorical tags, confidence score; precision target >=85% for top tags.
- Latency: p95 per-ticket TL; generation + tagging <= 700ms for 80% traffic, <=1200ms during spikes (they prefer dedicated but will try hosted).
- Throughput: baseline 50 rps, burst to 300 rps for marketing drops; autoscale/fallback rules must be proven.
- Tool-calling: call Zendesk API to fetch order details (mask PII), generate suggested macro (refund/partial refund/escalate). Must support idempotent retries.
- Auditing: all generated summaries and tags retained for 90 days; immutable audit log entry for each edit by agent.

Business considerations:
- Cost sensitivity: want to keep tokens under $0.015/ticket equivalent; interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization + batching).
- Procurement: procurement kickoff after legal/reg review (blocker: residency + retention controls).
- Champion: Support Ops Lead (Nora Patel) + Head of CX (Tom Hargreaves).

POC artifacts and links referenced during calls:
- Zendesk sandbox shared (zsd-elmbridge-sandbox).
- Fireflies transcript ff_20260208_elmbridge_poc (link above).
- Drive: Elmbridge_POC_SLA_and_Tech_Reqs.pdf (uploaded).

Quotes / call snippets:
- Nora: "If summaries land we can shave 20-30s per ticket and reduce escalations."
- Tom: "We need deterministic routing during our next marketing drop — can't have classifier drift mid-run."

Open action items (next 2 weeks):
- Redwood: provide perf baseline for hosted_api + recommended dedicated sizing for 6x spikes (Diego).
- Elmbridge: confirm SAML IdP test window and complete legal redline on data residency clause (Nora + Legal).
- Joint: run A/B on tagging model variants vs rule-based macros; capture precision/recall.

Notes on risk: partial POC results show tagging precision drop on long multipart email threads; possible mitigation: longer context KV caching + two-stage modelling (extractive then abstractive). Also need to validate audit log immutability for compliance.

Short-term ask: Finish spike test with caching enabled, deliver per-route latency profile, and price estimate for dedicated reserved capacity for peak windows.
